post.description: Makes one language-model call with the server's keys, for clients that run their own agent loop (desktop cowork). The body mirrors the AI SDK's `LanguageModelV4CallOptions` plus `model`, `context` and `stream`. Keys are resolved for the chat context, the budget is checked first (402), and usage is recorded against the caller and the context. With `stream: false` the reply is JSON (a `LanguageModelV4GenerateResult`); with `stream: true` it is Server-Sent Events whose `data` is one JSON `LanguageModelV4StreamPart`, ending with `data: [DONE]`. A failure after the stream starts is a final `error` part whose `error` is a `RunError`. There is no resume: a dropped stream is a failed call, and closing the request cancels it.

200.description: The result as JSON (`stream: false`) or an event stream (`stream: true`).

x-resolved-model.description: The model ref the selector resolved to.

402.description: The budget for this period is spent.

403.description: You don't have access to this.

503.description: No model provider is available for this request.

get.description: Streams a run as Server-Sent Events using the AI SDK UI message stream protocol (header `x-vercel-ai-ui-message-stream: v1`). Each event's `data` is one JSON `UIMessageChunk` and its `id` is the chunk's sequence number; the stream ends with `data: [DONE]`. Reconnect with `?cursor=<last id>` or a `Last-Event-ID` header to resume without gaps or repeats. A finished run replays and closes.

parameters.description: The last sequence number received; 0 replays from the start.
parameters.name: cursor

parameters.description: Standard SSE resume header; `cursor` wins if both are sent.
parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
